text:
sara_cs: Heads up — CobaltMed asked for a compact enablement day next Tuesday to unblock a renewal decision. They want a 2x45m block + 1x30m follow-up office hours, all within their EU/APAC windows.

maria_enable: Thanks. Can we do 09:30–10:15 CET and 18:00–18:45 CET? That hits EMEA morning + APAC late-late.

devon_se: I'll cover the first session (infra + migration checklist). POV: split agenda into product overview, migration checklist, hands-on lab (20m), Q&A.

liam_support: I can take follow-up office hours 18:00–18:30 CET for post-workshop troubleshooting.

olivia_pm: Need to flag renewal risk score 7/10 — exec stakeholder will attend for the first 30m. Keep the roadmap ask concise.

sara_cs: Good call. Maria — can you lead the hands-on lab? Need facilitator for the live workspace demo.

maria_enable: Yep I can. Suggest pre-read with quick start + a prompt pack link. I'll draft and post by EOD.

devon_se: Can we add a short runbook snippet for Dedicated -> Private migration pitfalls? Paste below:

```
Runbook excerpt:
- confirm model pinning
- validate KV cache persistence
- quota bump for warmup
- rollback plan: pin previous model and notify traffic router
```

sara_cs: Perfect. Also want to capture feedback. Liam — can you run the short 3-question survey at the end? I'll add to the calendar invite.

liam_support: Yep — I'll post the short Google Form and embed link in post-workshop email.

olivia_pm: Who's on slide duty for the 15m exec overview? Need one slide with ROI + next steps.

maria_enable: I'll do it. Will include renewal ask with clear options.

calendar_bot: Created provisional events: 2024-11-12 09:30 CET (Session A), 2024-11-12 18:00 CET (Session B), 2024-11-12 18:30 CET (Office hours). Invite link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/evt/clk123 :calendar:

sara_cs: Awesome. Last ask — capture attendee list from CobaltMed (specifically tech lead + procurement). @olivia_pm can you DM their contact to me?

olivia_pm: Sent via DM.

devon_se: One operational ask — recommend we enable short-lived credentials for the lab (expiring 4 hours). I'll attach IAM snippet to the invite.

maria_enable: Draft agenda for invite (short):
- 09:30 Executive 15m (ROI + decision lens)
- 09:45 Product + migration checklist 30m
- 10:15 Hands-on lab 20m
- 10:35 Q&A & next steps 10m

sara_cs: Great. If no objections I'll lock invites by end of day and send pre-read + prompt pack.

liam_support: No objections from my side. :thumbsup:

olivia_pm: Approved.

sara_cs: Locking it in. Post any changes here. Thanks team! :raised_hands:
